body: so proud i could burst 🥹 Greta Gerwig is the one handing taylor the Sherry Lansing Leadership Award at THR's Women in Entertainment gala, and THR's editor says she won "on the question of who owns her work." she really did https://www.longlivets.com/?item=vault-tloas-taylor-gets-the-2026-sherry-lansing-leadership-award-with-gr&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=heartbeat
why: Calendar beat 11-24 16:00Z experiment variant. Pride first, then the presenter, past honorees and the Roshan line on ownership. Earlier X draft (PR #6815) named Oprah, who is not in the sourced honoree list; dropped. Source: seed moment showgirl-sherry-lansing-leadership-award (supabase/seed/content/the-life-of-a-showgirl.mjs), citing Billboard and THR, Nov. 11, 2026; award announced, gala not yet held (usually early December, date unannounced). Quotes copied exactly from that record. Photo is the pre-computed alternate (wikimedia-22985418, Taylor at GMA, Red launch week, 2012); the beat's first pick wikimedia-22985355 failed the same-picture check. The calendar asked for a current-era photo, but the Showgirl pool's next pick is an official-video thumbnail the checker rightly refuses; the Red photo earns its place through the ownership line, Red being an album she later remade as Taylor's Version.

critique.rationale: Leads on pride that Greta Gerwig is the presenter, then three checkable details from Billboard/THR: the award, past honorees, and Roshan's exact line on ownership. The photo is Taylor at Red launch week, a reminder of the ownership story.
